description: Reviewed standards rules. A rule states a selector and either an allow-list or a deny-list over request paths.

rules.description: Production and recovery environments require a protected internal service class.
rules.remediation: Select a protected security profile or use a non-production environment.

rules.description: Production and recovery environments require protected log collection.
An enabled restricted zone requires a multi-zone availability profile.
rules.remediation: Select the high availability profile or disable the restricted zone.

rules.description: Declared recovery requires an isolated backup binding.
Public ingress is not an implemented exposure path in this repository.
rules.remediation: Remove public ingress; only internal OZ/RZ composition is implemented.

rules.description: Internet egress is not an implemented exposure path in this repository.
rules.remediation: Remove internet egress; only internal OZ/RZ composition is implemented.

rules.description: Only the internal IPv4 address family is implemented.
Accelerator and deferred compute classes are not implemented.
rules.remediation: Use the small, medium or large compute profile.

rules.description: Encrypted storage class custody is not implemented.
rules.remediation: Use the standard or high-capacity storage profile.

rules.description: A standalone local identity store is not an accepted identity boundary.
rules.remediation: Use the enterprise directory identity profile.
